description: This file defines and registers special character sets and related UI components for CKEditor5, including classes for character grids, info views, and plugin registration for various categories of special characters.

classes.name: f
classes.description: Utility class for injecting style elements into the document.

classes.name: x
classes.description: View class for displaying character information, including name and code point.
Main view class managing categories, grid, and info views for special characters, with focus and keyboard handling.

classes.name: S
classes.description: View class for character categories dropdown menu.

classes.name: P
classes.description: CKEditor plugin class for managing special characters, including categories and UI components.

classes.name: V
classes.description: View class for arrow characters category.

classes.name: A
classes.description: View class for text characters category.

classes.name: N
classes.description: View class for mathematical characters category.

classes.name: D
classes.description: View class for Latin characters category.

classes.name: E
classes.description: View class for currency characters category.

methods.name: y
methods.description: Converts a character's code point to a Unicode string with 'U+' prefix.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the character grid view, setting up focus and keyboard handling.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up focus and keyboard handlers.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus to the first character in the grid.

methods.name: _setupDropdown
methods.description: Initializes the category dropdown menu with options.
